summary: A touchline frame without its exchange (e) reaches the one subscribed scrip with its token, and is dropped once two subscribed exchanges share the token, as the web routes it (audit FB-08).

notes: Audit FB-08: web <member>_adapter.py _resolve_scrip; the desktop routes by e|tk and falls back to a unique token (families/noren/streaming.rs NorenFeed::route).
The second token-2885 subscription (CDS) makes the token ambiguous: both drop that frame.

deviations.reason: The web's Shoonya adapter forwards Noren's ltt as text (HH:MM:SS), or null when the frame has none; feed times are epoch milliseconds (docs), and a text copy of a time is not sent (docs/port/market-data-frames.md). The Noren family sends no ltt key (feed/dialect/names.rs).
Noren's touchline carries the book totals (tbq, tsq), and the web's Shoonya Quote dict drops them: lost data. The desktop keeps them (lead decision: data a web adapter drops from a mode is kept).
